I have farmed maize on this small rented land for many years, and I know the soil needs some help. I will buy two bags of NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer in town because maize cannot grow well without it, but I cannot afford too much since I do not own this plot. I also have chicken manure from my backyard which I will spread to make the soil soft. I will use seed I saved from last season, and my children will help me with the planting and weeding, but I will pay two young men from the village to help me clear the bush at the start.
